resolved_before_acceptance: Current per-item policy versions are enforced for storage, retrieval and report authorization.
Android opens the report socket on the captured active Network without default-network fallback.
Review subject, result hashes, command hashes and output hashes are bound and checked exactly.
Consent lock recovery and release verify PID, token, device and inode ownership.
Pre-login consent binds atomically to the authenticated field actor and requires reconsent for another actor.
Every report conservatively requires automatic-reporting consent because client purpose is not attestable.
Gateway test counts are parsed from the canonical log and unsupported Android count claims were removed.
All post-acquisition consent and network blocks release the report-attempt lease.
known_nonblocking_boundaries: TC-FP-013-01 through TC-FP-013-05 and the planned 279 formal tests were not run.
Legal and privacy review and approved final consent copy were not run.
Actual users, guardians, TalkBack users, devices and production networks were not tested.
Production credentials and deployment were not run.
Five release gates remain not run and release remains not eligible.
Network transport is Android-observed rather than hardware-backed attestation.
